newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover was 1.481 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded. Turnover for Saturday is not available.
Traders said trading was slow with the market still in a holiday mood after two extra days off to mark the Chinese takeover of Hong Kong.
Both state banks and short-term financial centres, money borkerages run by the central bank, traded less than usual following the holiday, they said.
"Weak performance of the stock markets on Wednesday also contributed to the low interbank turnover," one trader said.
Traders said they expected the interbank rates to move narrowly around the current level but on enlarged volume in the next few days.
